purpose: A glass-box coding agent whose every action is proposed, gated, and logged. The claims must be proven by measurement, not asserted by architecture.

steps.title: Agent foundation: loop, tools, policy, trace
steps.why: A working agent whose behaviour is observable and attributable.
covered: atomic read tools with bounded output
propose/apply split with single-use proposal ids
approval gate bound to a payload fingerprint and an operator identity
path jail with separate read and write boundaries
JSONL trace with a declared, validated schema

steps.title: Measure the agent against real tasks
steps.why: Every capability so far is asserted, not measured. Until there is a score, 'it works' is an opinion and every extension is a guess.
covered: evals/ harness: 5 cases with deterministic assertions, no LLM judge
per-case isolated workspaces so order cannot change the score
pinned model and git sha recorded, so a score is attributable
negative control proves the suite reports failure, not just success
baseline: 5/5 on commit b3a9d21 with deepseek-v4.1-flash:cloud

steps.title: Extend based on what evals reveal
steps.why: The expected gap is verification: without run_command the agent cannot prove its edits work. Build only what measurement justifies, not what sounds complete.

steps.title: LangChain and LangGraph as measured comparisons
steps.why: Compare frameworks against a scored baseline instead of porting for its own sake. The deliverable is evidence about what they hide and what they cost.

not_in_plan: Web UI, trace viewer, or dashboard
Deployment, packaging, or publishing to PyPI
A reviewer agent until the eval step is complete (backlogged)
Any new guardrail not demanded by a failing eval or a real defect
